preconditions: explicit orientation basis and support distance

variables.alpha: signed apparent dip in the vertical section

decisionLogic: An unfilled contact produces no candidate. A filled SyntheticAssumption or EvidenceCandidate produces a finite support-bounded diagnostic line only. This rule never grants real-region authorization.
uncertainty: One conservative symmetric angular bound is applied independently to true dip and dip direction. Exact slope extrema include interval endpoints and any cosine extrema inside the direction interval; the resulting elevation envelope is retained at both support endpoints and the anchor.
validationMethod: analytic alignment case, sign check, exact angular-envelope extrema, hash tamper rejection, premature authorization rejection and pairwise order audit
reopenCondition: Implement artifact-bound independent review, correlated angle uncertainties or topology-aware multi-contact assembly.
